name: Luxembourg

income_tax.summary: Luxembourg taxes residents on a 23-bracket class 1 scale: 0% to EUR 13,230, then 8% rising by one point or two points per band to 39% from EUR 54,090, 40%, 41% and a top rate of 42% above EUR 234,870, plus a 7% solidarity surcharge (9% above EUR 150,000), giving a top rate of about 45.8%. Employees pay about 12.7% social security on income up to a ceiling of about EUR 166,280; the self-employed pay both shares, roughly 26% of income.
income_tax.self_employed_notes: CCSS social parameters 2026 (updated 29.05.2026), total contribution rates: sickness in kind 5.60%, sickness cash benefits 0.50%, dependency 1.40%, pension 17.00%, accident 0.65% (before the accident insurance association's bonus-malus factor) = 25.15%, shown as the rate. Both shares are paid by the self-employed person. Base is professional income, floor = social minimum wage (EUR 2,771.33 a month from 1 June 2026), ceiling EUR 13,856.63 a month = EUR 166,279.56 a year. Not included: optional employers' mutual insurance (0.23%-2.66% by class) and the occupational-health rate of 0.14%, whose applicability to the self-employed the page does not state. Dependency contribution is levied after a fixed monthly deduction (as for employees), so the effective rate on EUR 54,000 is slightly below 25.15%. Replaces the earlier ~26% director estimate from Fiduciaire LPG.
income_tax.local_tax_note: Class 1 (single) scale from PwC (partial) completed from macalculatriceenligne.com; solidarity surcharge (contribution to the employment fund) 7% of tax, 9% where income exceeds EUR 150,000 (applied here as a marginal rate from EUR 150,000, which overstates it slightly, and the source does not say whether 9% applies to the whole tax). Rates in the table already include it (rate x 1.07 or x 1.09). Employee 12.7% = sickness 2.8% + pension 8.5% (ceiling EUR 13,856.63 a month) + dependency insurance 1.4%.

regimes.name: Impatriate regime (from tax year 2025)
regimes.description: Half of the gross annual remuneration of an impatriate is exempt from income tax, capped at an exemption of EUR 400,000 a year. Conditions: Luxembourg resident; recruited from abroad or seconded; no residence or Luxembourg tax liability and no living within 150 km of the Luxembourg border in the previous five years; gross annual pay at least EUR 75,000; impatriates not above 30% of the company's workforce (waived for companies under ten years old); at least 75% of working time on the qualifying activity; employer reports impatriates by 31 January each year.

sources.title: Tax and legal considerations of the new impatriate regime

rent_1bed_monthly.description: Numbeo average monthly rent for a 1-bedroom city-centre apartment, Luxembourg City; crowd-sourced, 789 entries from 111 contributors in the past 12 months, last updated 12 October 2026. Unfurnished/furnished not distinguished. Numbeo gives only 1-bedroom and 3-bedroom figures, so no 2-bedroom value is recorded.

source.title: Cost of living in Luxembourg (rent prices)

rent_2bed_monthly.description: Investropa 2026 average monthly rent for a 2-bedroom apartment in Luxembourg City; typical range EUR 2,200-3,200. Size and furnished status not stated. Benchmark estimate, not an official statistic.

costs.notes: Numbeo 3-bedroom city-centre average EUR 3,208.46 as a cross-check; no 2-bedroom value. Check pass 2026-10-15: the Observatoire de l'habitat (Ministry of Housing, listings from Immotop.lu, 1 July 2025 - 30 June 2026) gives an average advertised apartment rent of EUR 2,032 a month (EUR 50.17 per m2, 5,655 listings) for the commune of Luxembourg, all apartment sizes mixed, so no 2-bedroom value could be derived; source https://logement.public.lu/fr/observatoire-habitat/prix-de-location/loyers-annonces-logements.html (data file offre-et-prix-annonces-location-appartements-2026t2.xls).

residence_routes: EU/EEA and Swiss citizens may live and work freely and register with the commune. Luxembourg has no digital nomad visa (not confirmed on an official page). Skilled non-EU employees need a Luxembourg employment contract and a work and residence authorisation or EU Blue Card; thresholds were not verified.
open_questions: Nomad visa absence, Blue Card/authorisation salary thresholds not verified from an official page.
